basics.name: Peter Kidney
basics.label: Commercial Strategy Advisor
basics.summary: Chartered Accountant with extensive experience in medical diagnostics and healthcare commercialization. Co-founded a medical diagnostics company that secured €17 million in funding, successfully obtained CE-marking for 17 diagnostic products, and established partnerships with 42 international distributors. Currently focused on innovative technologies for early-stage cancer screening diagnostics from non-invasive patient samples. Provides essential insights into regulatory pathways, business planning, and commercialization strategies for healthcare startups.

work.position: Finance specialist, startups and stock exchange listings, focus on disruptive medical diagnostics
work.summary: Chartered Accountant with experience in both public and private companies at CFO, CEO, Chairman and non executive director level, with a particular focus on business planning for pre-revenue companies to guide them into revenue generation. Currently focused on innovative technologies for early stage cancer screening diagnostics from non-invasive patient samples.
Co-founded a medical diagnostics company that achieved significant milestones in the healthcare industry.
highlights: Raised €17 million in equity, debt and grants
Obtained CE-marking for 17 medical diagnostic products
